title: 数据倾斜检测与加盐打散：两阶段聚合的负载均衡度

# 数据倾斜检测与加盐打散：两阶段聚合前后的 reducer 负载均衡度
import statistics
import zlib

NUM_PART = 16
SALT_N = 8
SKEW_RATIO_TH = 5.0      # 最大分区 / 中位数 > 5 判定为倾斜
SKEW_ABS_TH = 10000      # 且最大分区绝对值超过 1 万条


def part_of(text, num_parts):
    return zlib.crc32(text.encode("utf-8")) % num_parts


def split_even(cnt, n):
    """把一个 key 的记录数均分成 n 份（差值 <= 1，保证求和不变）。"""
    shares = [cnt // n] * n
    for i in range(cnt % n):
        shares[i] += 1
    return shares


def direct_loads(keys):
    loads = [0] * NUM_PART
    for key, cnt in keys:
        loads[part_of(key, NUM_PART)] += cnt
    return loads


def salted_loads(keys):
    loads = [0] * NUM_PART
    stage2_records = 0
    for key, cnt in keys:
        shares = split_even(cnt, SALT_N)
        for s in range(SALT_N):
            loads[part_of(key + "#" + str(s), NUM_PART)] += shares[s]
            stage2_records += 1
    return loads, stage2_records


def describe(loads):
    mx = max(loads)
    md = statistics.median(loads)
    ratio = round(mx / md, 2) if md else 0.0
    return mx, md, ratio


def is_skewed(loads):
    mx, md, ratio = describe(loads)
    hot = [i for i, v in enumerate(loads) if v == mx]
    return (ratio > SKEW_RATIO_TH and mx > SKEW_ABS_TH), ratio, mx, md, hot


# ---- 用例 A：存在热 key ----
KEYS_A = [("k_hot", 50000)] + [("k" + str(i).rjust(4, "0"), 80 + i % 20) for i in range(200)]
# ---- 用例 B：分布均匀 ----
KEYS_B = [("k" + str(i).rjust(4, "0"), 1000) for i in range(200)]


def report(tag, keys, expect_skew):
    total_rows = sum(c for _, c in keys)
    d_loads = direct_loads(keys)
    skewed_a, ratio_a, mx_a, md_a, hot_a = is_skewed(d_loads)
    s_loads, s2 = salted_loads(keys)
    mx_s, md_s, ratio_s = describe(s_loads)
    skewed_s, _, _, _, _ = is_skewed(s_loads)

    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("存在热 key（期望检出倾斜）" if expect_skew
                                  else "分布均匀（期望不倾斜）") + " ==")
    print("  key 数 = " + str(len(keys)) + "，总记录数 = " + str(total_rows) +
          "，reducer 数 = " + str(NUM_PART))
    print("  【加盐前】最大分区=" + str(mx_a) + " 中位数=" + str(md_a) +
          " 倾斜度=" + str(ratio_a) + " 热分区下标=" + str(hot_a))
    print("  【加盐后】最大分区=" + str(mx_s) + " 中位数=" + str(md_s) +
          " 倾斜度=" + str(ratio_s) + "（加盐份数=" + str(SALT_N) + "）")
    print("  是否判定为倾斜（加盐前） = " + str(skewed_a))
    print("  加盐后是否仍判定为倾斜 = " + str(skewed_s))
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(skewed_a == expect_skew))
    # 结果正确性：两阶段聚合后每个 key 的总量必须与原始一致
    before = dict(keys)
    after = {}
    for key, cnt in keys:
        acc = 0
        for s in range(SALT_N):
            acc += sum(split_even(cnt, SALT_N)) / SALT_N
        after[key] = int(acc)
    consistent = all(before[k] == after[k] for k in before)
    print("  两阶段聚合结果与原结果一致 = " + str(consistent) +
          "（stage2 记录数=" + str(s2) + "）")
    return skewed_a, ratio_a, mx_a, ratio_s, mx_s, consistent


ra = report("A", KEYS_A, True)
print("")
rb = report("B", KEYS_B, False)

print("")
print("判据 1（热 key 场景被检出倾斜: 倾斜度 " + str(ra[1]) + " > " + str(SKEW_RATIO_TH) +
      "）: " + str(ra[0]))
print("判据 2（均匀场景不判定倾斜: 倾斜度 " + str(rb[1]) + "）: " + str(not rb[0]))
print("判据 3（加盐打散生效: 最慢分区负载 " + str(ra[4]) + " < " + str(ra[2]) + "）: " +
      str(ra[4] < ra[2]))
print("判据 4（最慢 reducer 负载下降倍数 = " + str(round(ra[2] / ra[4], 2)) + "）: " +
      str(ra[2] / ra[4] > 2))
print("判据 5（加盐不改变聚合结果）: " + str(ra[5] and rb[5]))
